name: @singularity/plugin-network-live
description: Unified live-resource API. core: liveCollection (one declaration minting a bounded window resource and its point-set `:rows` sibling), the LiveWhere filter language and its op table (in-memory tests), and the strict canonical query codec. server: serveCollection (binds a collection's filterable/sortable names to a table's columns and compiles its window + point resources) and the op table's SQL half. web: useLive (window with canGrow/growing/loadMore, or an id set) and useLiveRow (pending / found / absent).
